simple.summary: סָעַד (çâʻad) means to support (mostly figurative) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 13 7.

definitions.usage: comfort, establish, hold up, refresh self, strengthen, be upholden.
definitions.full: H5582. saad סָעַד verb support, sustain, stay (Late Hebrew id. , especially take a meal ; Aramaic סְעַד support, stay ; Zinjirli סעד strengthen Lzb 330 , support , perhaps feed Cook 85 ; Christian-Palestinian Aramaic noun aid , Schw Idioticon 64 ; Arabic , III, IV. aid, assist , Lane 1360 , forearm Id 1362 ; Sabean סעד DHM Südar. Ait. p. 16 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular וְסָעַד consecutive Prov 20:28 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִסְעָ֑ד 3feminine singular suffix תִּסְעָדֵ֫נִי Psa 18:36 , read also in || 2Sam 22:36 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular סְעָד Judg 19:5 (on ָ probably © by error, see Kö i. 261 f. GFM on the passage ), סְעָדנָֿא 19:8 (compare id. ), וּסֳעָ֑דָה 1Kin 13:7 ; suffix סְעָדֵנִי Psa 119:117 ; Infinitive construct suffix וּלְסַעֲדָהּ Isa 9:6 ; — support, sustain , always figurative: 1 sustain, stay , the heart (compare לֵבָב 8 , לֵב 8 ), with food Gen 18:5 (J), Judg 19:5 (c. 2 accusative), 19:8 , Psa 104:15 ; object omitted 1Kin 13:7 . 2. a. support throne (subject king) Prov 20:28 , coming ruler Isa 9:6 . b. support, uphold with accusative of person (subject ׳י , his hand etc.) Psa 18:36 + || 2Sam 22:36 (v above ), Psa 20:3 ; 41:4 ; 94:18 ; 119:117 .
